concerns.text: The plan’s core research question is to assess how simulated social rejection modulates *neural responses to positive feedback* (behavioral proxies). However, the only dataset used (OpenNeuro ds000208) contains only Cyberball rejection/control variables (reaction time, mood) and **does not include any positive‑feedback or reward‑feedback measurements**. The analysis therefore compares rejection vs. control on the same task’s RT and mood, which does not capture “responses to positive feedback”. This mismatch means the metric (ANOVA on RT/mood) cannot validly address the stated hypothesis about modulation of responses to positive feedback, rendering the scientific claim unsupported.
